deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connection to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The proposed infrastructure would support smart contract settlement, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, wallet and API ecosystem layers, banking rails, stablecoin systems, and Visa card issuance linked to onchain balances.
Wirex is asserted to have more than 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal claims Cardano currently lacks seamless rails for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.
The proposer claims the project will increase Cardano utility by unlocking new transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity onchain.
The proposal states that all components will be released as a public good for wallet providers, fintechs, stablecoin issuers, and developers to reuse.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to proposal, documentation, audited results, and audit references.
The proposer states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states Intersect will manage funds through a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified stake/payment addresses, milestone-based disbursement controls, and oversight by six named external entities.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for Wirex payment infrastructure through Intersect-managed treasury contracts, with claims of broad payments utility, public-good infrastructure, prior Hydra voting support, NCL compliance, and milestone-based oversight.
